name: Bond ladder
title: Bond ladder: Formula, Worked Example and Limits
description: A bond ladder holds securities with staggered maturities so principal becomes payable at different times, while any coupons follow each security’s separate payment schedule.
definition: A bond ladder holds securities with staggered maturities so principal becomes payable at different times, while any coupons follow each security’s separate payment schedule.
explanation: A bond ladder staggers principal maturities; coupon income and returned principal are different cash flows. Three $10,000 par bonds paying 4% and maturing in one, two and three years return $30,000 face plus $2,400 coupons when allowed to run off.
formula: Retained cash = coupons + principal redemptions − renewal purchases. Cash + outstanding purchase cost − initial cost = modeled realized cash-flow gain.
formulaNote: Original USD cash-flow ladder with 1–20 regular-coupon bonds or discount bills. Common settlement, manually entered prices, explicit horizon, no default/call/fees/tax/early sale. Coupon bonds settle just after a coupon; renewals are semiannual at par. Bill renewals use same face and an entered future price. Outstanding cost and face are not market values.

example.title: Let three coupon bonds mature without renewal
example.intro:
settlement: 2026-12-01; rungs: 10000, 100, 4, 2, 2
10000, 100, 4, 4, 2
10000, 100, 4, 6, 2; horizon_months: 36; maturity: Retain maturity proceeds; renewal_months: 36; renewal_coupon: 4
steps: All three $10,000 bonds are bought at par; initial cost = $30,000.
Semiannual coupons are $200 per bond. They pay 2, 4 and 6 remaining coupons, totaling $2,400.
Retained cash after all original maturities = $30,000 + $2,400 = $32,400.
example.answer: Retained cash through horizon: 32,400.00 for the stated case.
example.assumptions: Original USD cash-flow ladder with 1–20 regular-coupon bonds or discount bills. Common settlement, manually entered prices, explicit horizon, no default/call/fees/tax/early sale. Coupon bonds settle just after a coupon; renewals are semiannual at par. Bill renewals use same face and an entered future price. Outstanding cost and face are not market values.

pitfall.title: Read the cash-flow and rule boundary
pitfall.text: Principal coming back is not all interest. Outstanding face and cost are not guaranteed sale prices; cash-flow gain is not a tax calculation or a total-return ranking.

name: Medicare IRMAA
title: Medicare IRMAA: Formula, Worked Example and Limits
description: Medicare IRMAA is the income-related monthly adjustment added to Part B and prescription-drug coverage premiums for beneficiaries above the applicable MAGI threshold.
definition: Medicare IRMAA is the income-related monthly adjustment added to Part B and prescription-drug coverage premiums for beneficiaries above the applicable MAGI threshold.
explanation: IRMAA adds income-related charges to Medicare Part B and Part D premiums. Under the official 2027 table, individual MAGI of $112,000 has no surcharge; $112,001 enters a bracket with $83.70 Part B and $15.40 Part D IRMAA per person per month.
formula: Medicare IRMAA MAGI = AGI + tax-exempt interest. Monthly surcharge = applicable Part B adjustment + Part D adjustment for selected coverage, per covered person.
formulaNote: U.S. full-Part-B and Part-D IRMAA for official premium years 2026/2027, using entered Medicare MAGI or known AGI plus tax-exempt interest. Selected coverage and one person, or two identically covered people on a joint return, annualized for 12 months. No SSA determination, appeal, subsidy, hold-harmless, tax optimization or immunosuppressive-drug-only premium model.

example.title: Use the exact 2027 first threshold
example.intro: year: 2027; status: Single / head of household / qualifying surviving spouse; coverage: Part B + Part D; people: 1; part_d_plan: 35; extra_income: 1000; magi: 112000
steps: 2027 individual MAGI at 112,000 remains in the zero-IRMAA tier.
Full Part B standard premium 209.40 plus the hypothetical entered Part D plan premium 35 gives 244.40 per month; none of that is IRMAA.
example.answer: Monthly IRMAA for selected people: 0.00 for the stated case.

pitfall.title: Read the cash-flow and rule boundary
pitfall.text: Do not apply a premium-year table to the wrong income year, count a joint-return surcharge only once when both spouses are covered, or substitute Part D IRMAA for the separate plan premium.
